model.scopes: Six overlapping hard residual limits, same debit; not six independent wallets.
model.completion: For single first-event credit D after first request and nonnegative later costs, all scopes must support max(first-request minimum, required final prefix + minimum - effective scope credit).
model.recognition: At fixed initial headroom vector, the necessary scopes to adjust are precisely those below the gross threshold, provided every scope meets the full-recognition threshold (up to source floating-point microgrid).
model.limits: Counterfactual cap change not actual refund; observed usage only, no actual scope budgets or damages. Cannot infer welfare without protected other workloads or governance costs.
